name: question-log
description: Highlights assistant replies that end by asking you something, logs every AskUserQuestion and detected question with its answer, and shows them in a /questions pane with a '? N open' status line.

detectQuestions.title: Detect questions in replies
detectQuestions.description: Log an assistant reply whose final paragraph asks you something as an open question, answered by your next prompt.

highlight.title: Highlight question replies
highlight.description: Draw replies detected as questions in a coloured, bordered box with a '? Question for you' header.
